journal_failure.detail: memory os librarian cancelled lane=librarian_exact before commit

source_diagnosis.post_turn_submission: Keeper_agent_run_post_turn_memory submits Librarian work asynchronously to the detached per-Keeper memory lane.
source_diagnosis.graceful_shutdown_behavior: Both Keeper keepalive cleanup and explicit shutdown preparation called cancel_and_join_librarian, which requested cancellation before awaiting the lane exit.
source_diagnosis.cadence_behavior: Cancellation leaves the process-local cadence counter due, so a later turn can schedule a new pass.
source_diagnosis.input_replay_behavior: The cancelled immutable input is not durable and is not replayed. Official-client turns construct the next Librarian input from the new assistant message rather than the cancelled turn-10 closure.
source_diagnosis.restart_implication: The prior revision remains readable, but Harbor-3 and glasswing are absent from revision 3. Restart recall of the latest cadence window is therefore not proven and can lose facts that a later assistant message does not repeat.

remediation_pr.head: 89b359a1a08452153a44da11fead256f4ffb9c56
remediation_pr.scope: Graceful Keeper lifecycle fences admission, drains and joins current plus retained-latest Librarian work, preserves the exact owner receipt, persists Joining_lanes before stop, and fails closed on incomplete live join replay. Process-root cancellation remains unchanged.

proves: The first three cadence passes committed revisions 1 through 3.
The prior snapshot remained intact when graceful shutdown cancelled the fourth pass.
The fourth pass contained the latest facts and was cancelled before commit after 106.1 seconds.
The failed pass is visible in both the exact-lane registry and the Memory journal.
does_not_prove: The latest cadence window survives graceful Keeper shutdown.
A later turn replays the exact cancelled Librarian input.
Memory OS recalls Harbor-3 or the glasswing exception after restart.
Crash or process-restart preserves unconsumed memory-lane work.
required_follow_up: Graceful Keeper shutdown must drain and join retained Librarian work instead of cancelling it.
Exact-head CI must cover current plus retained-latest completion and the explicit shutdown path.
After deployment, rerun the ten-turn canary, stop it while the final pass is active, and prove the final revision plus restart recall in logs and Dashboard/browser.
